name: Sous-Chef's Hat
text: If you win no tricks in a round, gain +40 contract value.

signature.trigger: you win no tricks in a round

decision: None beyond the nil itself; it adds to your partner's contract when your nil holds.
opponent: Visible at scoring; opponents answer by breaking the nil.
aiNote: Count +40 for your partner's contract when weighing a nil.
rationale: A successful nil wins no tricks, so a nil deck that bids nil in half its rounds and succeeds three times in four earns about +15 a round in contract value, paid through the partner's contract and raised by multipliers, unlike nil value (Vigil Candle, PU-C10).
deviation: Revision 1: replaced paying for losing with the second-best card in a trick, which was hard to follow and rarely fired.
